description: Evaluation set for the knowledge base Q&A bot. Positive cases should answer using only the expected source. Negative cases should return the fallback answer and no sources.
fallback_answer: I cannot confirm from the knowledge base.

cases.query: Can I change my email address?
expected_facts: Customers can change their email address from Account Settings.
The new email must be verified before it becomes active.

cases.query: Where do users update the email on their account?
expected_facts: Customers can change their email address from Account Settings.
The new email must be verified before it becomes active.

cases.query: Does a new email work immediately after I save it?
expected_facts: The customer must verify the new email address before it becomes active.

cases.query: How do I reset my password?
expected_facts: Customers can reset their password from the sign-in page.
The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

cases.query: Where should a customer go if they forgot their password?
expected_facts: Customers can reset their password from the sign-in page.

cases.query: How long is a password reset link valid?
expected_facts: The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

cases.query: How can I delete my account?
expected_facts: Customers can request account deletion from Privacy Settings.
Deletion requests are completed within 14 days.

cases.query: Where do I submit a request to close my account?
expected_facts: Customers can request account deletion from Privacy Settings.

cases.query: How many days does account deletion take?
expected_facts: Deletion requests are completed within 14 days.

cases.query: How long does standard shipping take?
expected_facts: Standard shipping usually takes 3-5 business days after the order leaves the warehouse.

cases.query: When should a normal delivery arrive after it ships from the warehouse?
expected_facts: Standard shipping usually takes 3-5 business days after the order leaves the warehouse.

cases.query: Is standard delivery measured from purchase date or warehouse departure?
expected_facts: The 3-5 business day estimate starts after the order leaves the warehouse.

cases.query: How long does expedited shipping take?
expected_facts: Expedited shipping usually takes 1-2 business days.
Expedited shipping fees are not refundable after the package has shipped.

cases.query: What is the delivery estimate for rush shipping?
expected_facts: Expedited shipping usually takes 1-2 business days.

cases.query: Can I get the expedited shipping fee back after my package ships?
expected_facts: Expedited shipping fees are not refundable after the package has shipped.

cases.query: When will I get a tracking number?
expected_facts: Customers receive a tracking number by email after the warehouse creates the shipping label.

cases.query: How are customers notified of shipment tracking?
expected_facts: Customers receive a tracking number by email.

cases.query: Does the tracking code come before or after the shipping label is created?
expected_facts: The tracking number is sent after the warehouse creates the shipping label.

cases.query: How long do I have to cancel an order?
expected_facts: Customers can cancel an order within 24 hours after purchase if the order has not shipped yet.
After the order ships, customers must request a return instead of a cancellation.

cases.query: Can a customer cancel after the package has already shipped?
expected_facts: After the order ships, customers must request a return instead of a cancellation.

cases.query: What is the cancellation deadline after buying something?
expected_facts: Customers can cancel an order within 24 hours after purchase if the order has not shipped yet.

cases.query: How long do refunds take?
expected_facts: Approved refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.
The exact arrival time depends on the customer's bank or card provider.

cases.query: When should the money show up after a refund is approved?
expected_facts: Approved refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.
The exact arrival time depends on the customer's bank or card provider.

cases.query: Does my bank affect when I receive an approved refund?
expected_facts: The exact arrival time depends on the customer's bank or card provider.

cases.query: Which items are not refundable?
expected_facts: Digital gift cards, final sale items, and personalized products are not refundable unless required by local law.

cases.query: Can I return a personalized product for a refund?
expected_facts: Personalized products are not refundable unless required by local law.

cases.query: Are digital gift cards refundable?
expected_facts: Digital gift cards are not refundable unless required by local law.
